text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager (P1) — GPU pool saturation detected in gcp-us-east1. Queue length > 12k, avg wait ~48s, autoscaler failing to add nodes. Trigger: gpu_pool_utilization > 90% for 5m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota

sam: acked. I'm oncall — starting triage. Pulling autoscaler events and GCP error logs now.

sam: autoscaler log snippet shows repeated createInstance failures. Error: `QuotaExceeded` from compute API.

incident-bot: autoscaler error payload: {"error":"QUOTA_EXCEEDED","resource":"projects/redwood-prod/locations/us-east1"} (see logs)

sam: looks like region quota hit rather than transient pool shortage. Checking org-level quotas and other projects for spare GPUs.

leo: CS scoreboard: several mid-size customers reporting elevated latency and queued requests. Prioritization: SLA customers first. Looping in @amanda for customer comms.

amanda: acknowledged. Drafting notices. Need estimated ETA for mitigation before I send anything public.

sam: mitigation plan (initial):
  1) throttle non-SLA traffic at the edge to preserve capacity for high-priority jobs
  2) divert low-priority/embeddings to compact model pool (lower memory footprint)
  3) attempt manual allocation in us-west1 and file GCP quota increase request

sam: Applying edge throttle now. Command: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-internal/ops/rate-limits \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","qps":4,"policy":"priority-based"}'
```

elaine: I'm joining triage, taking lead at 17:48 UTC. Sam — what remains for handoff?

sam: throttle live (reduced non-SLA throughput ~60%). Redirected ~40% of low-priority traffic to compact models. Manual instance creation in us-west1 failing intermittently due to project-level GPU soft cap; filing quota increase (REQ-98765).

sam: log excerpt: 
```
2026-03-15T17:42:03Z autoscaler: error creating instance: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 12345, quota may be region-limited., quotaExceeded
```

incident-bot: Note: quota increase request REQ-98765 filed. GCP estimated review 2-4 hours.

elaine: If quota increase is delayed, plan B = burst to reserved capacity in us-east2 (we have committed reserved GPUs there). Will update routing to prefer us-east2 as failover. Initiating routing change now.

elaine: routing change payload (ops):
```json
{"route":"gpu-heavy","preferred_regions":["us-east2","us-west1"],"failover":"us-east2"}
```

ben: deploying quantized/smaller-model variants to increase replica density on existing GPUs (expect ~2x density). Rolling patch to runtime and model registry in progress.

sam: customer impact summary: ~12 customers in latency-sensitive tiers affected; 3 triggered pages. CS drafting targeted messages.

amanda: sending targeted notices to impacted customers now — message explains quota hit, immediate mitigations (throttle + route changes), and ETA 4–6h pending quota approval.

elaine: handing to night oncall @ben in 20m. Open items to track in handoff: monitor queue length, confirm routing/failover success to us-east2, confirm reserved pool capacity, and follow up on quota request. Add notes to incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/3467809123

ben: taking over. Initial observations: queue dropped from ~12k -> ~6k after throttle + model diversion. Monitoring for regressions. Will escalate to infra if backlog climbs.

sam: thanks everyone. Marking incident P1 and keeping it active until stable for 2h. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> partial. Auto-monitor scheduled for 2h before transition to postmortem.
